Settings · firmware sources

Where firmforge looks for firmware. Set once and forgotten — it starts with a few well-known publishers so it is useful immediately. Add your own by pasting a GitHub repository or a link to a published manifest.json.

firmforge links to each publisher's own downloads rather than rehosting their binaries. Every source here can be removed, and removals are remembered.

Run a script

Sent through MicroPython's raw REPL, so indentation survives and a traceback comes back separately from what the script printed.

Put a file on the board

Saved to the board's own filesystem and checked afterwards against its size and SHA-256. Name it main.py and it runs every time the board powers on.
